text: Explain why the seasons change on Earth to a curious teenager. Include a simple example and correct one common misconception.
Write a thoughtful short story about a librarian who discovers a letter hidden in an old atlas.
Explain how rivers shape a landscape over many years, using plain language and concrete examples.
Describe a quiet morning in a coastal village from the viewpoint of a baker opening her shop.
Give a practical plan for starting a small vegetable garden on a sunny balcony. Explain each choice.
Write a scene in which two old friends meet at a train station after ten years apart.
Explain how a household refrigerator transfers heat and why the room does not become colder.
Compare learning a musical instrument alone and with a teacher. Give useful advice for a beginner.
